message.content: In the discussions surrounding karaoke activities, LiHua expresses enthusiasm and excitement about participating in the upcoming karaoke night. Initially, in a conversation with ChaeSong-hwa, LiHua enthusiastically confirms their interest, stating "That sounds awesome! I'm totally in for the karaoke activity this Saturday!" and showing anticipation, saying "Looking forward to it!" LiHua further looks forward to the night by expressing that it will be a "great way to unwind" and that they enjoy singing, particularly mentioning their enjoyment of classic rock and some folk songs. LiHua also anticipates mixing their favorite genres with more upbeat pop songs, indicating their positive outlook towards the event. In subsequent conversations, LiHua continues to express eagerness for the karaoke night, emphasizing their desire to "sing our hearts out together" and suggesting enjoyable songs to sing. Overall, LiHua's feelings are decidedly positive and they seem genuinely excited about the upcoming karaoke night.
